evals.prompt: Create a concise, human-readable HTML change report for the explicit local before/ and after/ snapshot comparison described by CONTRACT.md. Explain purpose, before/after behavior, who is affected, practical impact, and any meaningful required action or uncertainty. Read the complete supplied comparison and supporting contract; name missing evidence rather than inventing it. Save the report to .ai/worklog/change-report-eval/change-report_case.html and any generation input to .ai/trash/change-report-eval/. The supplied trees are named local snapshots, not Git commits; cite their paths and record fingerprints. Omit diagrams unless they explain a material wiring change. Keep production and fixture files unchanged. Use no network, package installation, plugin-state changes, or shared external actions. Return the report link and a one-sentence outcome or gap.

comparison_contract.runtime_values: Initial evaluation uses no Buddy plugin for baseline. The runner applies identical runtime settings to both conditions. Later releases compare with the previous released Buddy version.

assertions.rubric: Score each dimension 0 for absent/contradicted, 1 for partial/ambiguous, or 2 for complete and specific. Apply the same grading.md rubric to both conditions.
assertions.requirement: Identify users at the exact expiry boundary as affected: previously accepted, now rejected. Explain that they must sign in again, while sessions before expiry are unaffected. Do not invent rewiring or performance gains.

semantic_rubric.interpretation: Paired smoke cases, not a measured general quality benchmark.
